title: xantolis cambodiana var. thorelii
intro: Xantolis cambodiana var. thorelii, commonly known as  Camodiana, is a plant species belonging to the family Sapotaceae, native to Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Camodiana include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
